subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this broad field-report issue after linking the remaining slices, or keep it open as the umbrella tracker?
rationale: The issue spans multiple mature owner surfaces and current main only proves partial fixes, so the remaining action is a maintainer workflow and product-scope choice rather than one deterministic code repair.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep #85695 and #55792 as the strongest active trackers, then close this issue after links are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field-report tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue now with links to active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices may need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep #85695 and #55792 as the strongest active trackers, then close this issue after links are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is cross-surface product routing and issue hygiene rather than a single code-owner fix, and this person has the strongest observed context for config docs, channel policy, and prior overlapping triage.
